hubs.name: hub_customer
hubs.description: A customer identified by the customer account number assigned by the accounting system; uniquely identifies the customer.

hubs.name: hub_store
hubs.description: A reseller store identified by its business entity reference. Asserted equivalent to hub_business_entity but keyed differently; modelled as its own hub per ratified decision.

hubs.name: hub_person_customer
hubs.description: A person who is an individual customer, identified by PersonID. Asserted equivalent to hub_person but keyed differently; modelled as its own hub per ratified decision.

hubs.name: hub_sales_order
hubs.description: A sales order identified by its sales order number, which uniquely identifies the order.

hubs.name: hub_sales_territory
hubs.description: A sales territory identified by its operational territory id; the consistent reference used to relate territories to all other sales entities.

links.name: link_customer_person
links.description: For an individual customer, the reference to the person who is the customer.

links.name: link_customer_store
links.description: For a store customer, the reference to the store.

links.name: link_customer_territory
links.description: The sales territory in which each customer is located; a customer is in exactly one territory at a time, a territory contains many customers.

links.name: link_sales_order_customer
links.description: The customer who placed each order; an order is placed by exactly one customer, a customer places many orders.

satellites.name: sat_customer_details
satellites.description: Descriptive attributes of the customer record from the operational system, including the kind-determining references and the last-modified date for change detection and reconciliation.
satellites.split_rationale: Single operational source row (Customer); last-modified date lives here as the sole change signal for the customer.
